newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Zhenghong to list 45 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhenghong to list 45 mln A shares.

text.p: Hunan Zhenghong Feed Co Ltd said on Friday it would list 45 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on March 18.
Zhenghong issued the A shares at 7.06 yuan each and completed the offer earlier this month, the company said in a statement issued in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The firm, a poultry and pig feeds processor, has 130.18 million outstanding shares, composed of 80.18 million state shares, 45 million A shares and 5.0 million staff shares.
The company is one of 33 domestic enterprises that has won approval from Beijing to list B shares. Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
The company forecast net profit of 62.36 million yuan for 1997, compared with an estimated 48.46 million for 1996 and 40.12 million booked for 1995.
Zhenghong said it began enjoying a three-year corporate tax break from the start of this year due to the local government's support for the feed processing industry.
In a prospectus, Zhenghong said it would use proceeds from the A share issue to expand its main business.
